title.en: Pictures from a Demo Day at Sony

subtitle.en: Photos from a Sony event in Foster City where the press got hands-on time with upcoming PS4 games.
subtitle.zh: Sony 在 Foster City 办的活动现场照片，媒体在那里试玩了即将上市的 PS4 游戏。

translator.note: 原文第一段里游戏名的斜体标记有错位（`*The W**itness*`），en 字段原样保留；另有一行把两张照片和一句关于《Flower》的文字混排在一起，按规范保留为一个段落、图片标记内联在前；图片链接指向原文上传的最大尺寸原图。

blocks.en: Sony had an event today at their offices in Foster City to give the press some hands-on time with upcoming games running on the PlayStation 4.
blocks.zh: Sony 今天在他们位于 Foster City 的办公室办了一场活动，让媒体亲手试玩即将登陆 PlayStation 4 的游戏。

blocks.en: *The W**itness* was among the games being shown! We were the only third-party game there. Also shown were a whole lot of Killzone: Shadow Fall, Knack, PS4 versions of Sound Shapes and Flower, and Resogun.
blocks.zh: 《The Witness》也在展示的游戏之列！我们是现场唯一的第三方游戏。同时展出的还有一大堆《Killzone: Shadow Fall》、《Knack》、PS4 版的《Sound Shapes》和《Flower》，以及《Resogun》。

blocks.en: I did some interviews and talked to a number of press people who are very interested in *The Witness*. I also took some photos.
blocks.zh: 我做了几个采访，和不少对《The Witness》非常感兴趣的媒体人士聊了聊。我还拍了一些照片。

blocks.en: Brad from Giant Bomb playing *The Witness*:
blocks.zh: 来自 Giant Bomb 的 Brad 在玩《The Witness》：

blocks.en: ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2013/10/IMG_0236.jpg) ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2013/10/IMG_0237.jpg) *Flower* at 1080p and 60Hz, with the new, more-sensitive controller, feels nice to play:
blocks.zh: （原文此处有两张图）《Flower》以 1080p 和 60Hz 运行，配上新的、更灵敏的手柄，玩起来很舒服：
